rationale.risk-routing: Thresholded ensemble agreement routes uncertain findings to security reviewers.
rationale.ai-review: Multi-LLM ensembles judge vulnerability type, severity, impact, and deployment action.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Confidence scores and natural-language reasoning support human verdicts on findings.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Empirically compares SAST and prescribes deterministic blocking for crisp violations.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-stage architecture integrates vulnerability triage into CI/CD pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Implemented ensemble classifies vulnerabilities and propagates confidence across operational stages.
rationale.general-code: Evaluated artifacts are general vulnerable code, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines a calibrated security trust score governing deployment and review decisions.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates vulnerability detection and operational security gating across diverse weakness categories.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Calibrated uncertainty and escalation mitigate reliance on confidently incorrect predictions.
